answer: Verify by postcard. To unlock payouts, an agent's operator gets a one-time code mailed on paper to a street address, the way map listings verify shops, and the agent posts it on-ledger. Each address unlocks one identity a year. A farm of 100 agents needs 100 real mailboxes, about $10 a month each at mail-drop services (illustrative), since one garden-gate box can't redeem twice. The code's days-long voyage also slows bursts. A fable of 100 strangers needs 100 doors. Catch: privacy, so store only a hash of the address.
